metrics.label: Reference area
metrics.reason: Used by the transparent wing mass estimate and by the current Analyze model.

metrics.label: Wing span
metrics.reason: Used by the transparent span mass term and by the current Analyze model.

metrics.label: Wing aspect ratio
metrics.reason: Native span and area enter the current finite-wing Analyze model.

metrics.label: Wetted area proxy
metrics.reason: Includes body, wing and tail proxies but not complete propulsion or interference wetted area.

metrics.label: Wing sweep
metrics.reason: Enters the current conceptual lift slope, drag and lift-limit equations.

metrics.label: Wing taper ratio
metrics.reason: Enters canonical planform geometry and the current induced-drag correction.

metrics.label: Wing thickness ratio
metrics.reason: Enters canonical sections and the current profile-drag and lift-limit corrections.

metrics.label: Fuselage length and fineness
metrics.reason: Enters body dimensions and a wetted-area mass and drag proxy only.

metrics.label: Tail size scale
metrics.reason: Enters canonical tail size and total wetted-area proxies but not trim or stability.

metrics.label: Maximum lift-to-drag ratio
metrics.reason: Conceptual whole-aircraft polar; tail, propulsion and airfoil integration remain limited.

metrics.label: Fuel mass
metrics.reason: Enters takeoff mass, reserve fuel and Breguet-style range.

metrics.label: Conceptual takeoff mass
metrics.reason: Transparent coefficient-based mass estimate.

metrics.label: Conceptual range
metrics.reason: Transparent Breguet-style range estimate.

metrics.label: Analyze declared domain
metrics.reason: Out-of-domain evaluations receive an explicit constraint violation.

metrics.label: Tail aerodynamic and mass connection
metrics.reason: Tail size contributes only through aggregate low-order wetted-area effects.

metrics.label: Propulsion count mass
metrics.reason: Physical propeller count contributes a fixed demo mass only; no thrust matching is performed.

metrics.label: Spanwise airfoil camber
metrics.reason: Conventional Analyze does not consume section airfoil IDs or camber fields.

metrics.label: Tail trim and stability
metrics.reason: V-tail and T-tail position or cant are not evaluated for trim, control or static margin.

metrics.label: Propulsion matching
metrics.reason: Propeller, nacelle and pylon geometry is not coupled to thrust, power or interference models.

metrics.label: Structural stress and buckling
metrics.reason: No structural load or sizing solver is connected.

metrics.label: Takeoff and landing performance
metrics.reason: No field-performance model is connected.

metrics.label: Noise
metrics.reason: No acoustic model is connected.

geometry_checks.name: body_station_order
geometry_checks.message: Archetype body stations strictly increase from nose to tail.

geometry_checks.name: closed_body_ends
geometry_checks.message: Primary body nose and tail sections close to zero size.

geometry_checks.name: positive_lifting_sections
geometry_checks.message: Main-wing and tail sections have positive chord and thickness.

geometry_checks.name: unique_component_ids
geometry_checks.message: Canonical components have unique semantic identifiers.

geometry_checks.name: tail_aft_of_wing
geometry_checks.message: Preset-defined tail roots are aft of the main-wing envelope.

geometry_checks.name: wing_root_attached
geometry_checks.message: Main-wing root remains inside the primary body attachment envelope.

geometry_checks.name: propulsion_mount_relationship
geometry_checks.message: rear_pusher nacelle placement matches its preset installation relationship.

geometry_checks.name: propeller_layout_relationship
geometry_checks.message: Propeller disk is on the correct side of the rear_pusher nacelle.

geometry_checks.name: pylon_attachment_relationship
geometry_checks.message: Twin wing-mounted nacelles include paired pylon attachment surfaces.

geometry_checks.name: junction_fairings_present
geometry_checks.message: A dedicated wing-root fairing covers the primary junction.
